source: DECISIONS.md D-021 (Tier 1: one-factor marginal grids at nominal elsewhere); D-032 (grids committed as data); D-046 revision (2026-08-11 sitting)
description: Per-axis marginal grids for the Tier-1 sweep. Committed here so 'tier cell counts correct' has a referent; code reads this file and never hardcodes a grid (gate_moderate.json discipline). Cells duplicating the nominal point collapse into one shared nominal cell (D-032). Where INTERFACE_SPEC §9/§9.1 gives only a range, the grid step is arbitrary and labeled in its basis.

rain.basis: arbitrary 10% steps over the committed 0–30% range (occlusion-step convention)

lens_contamination.basis: arbitrary 10% steps over the committed 0–50% range

tag_knockout_mask.basis: arbitrary Tier-1 marginal: none + each single-tag knockout; joint combinations are Tier-2 territory (IS §9: sampled over 2^9)

speed_outer_ms.basis: arbitrary 4-point grid over the committed 0.5–2.0 range (H-02)

speed_inner_ms.basis: arbitrary 3-point grid over the committed 0.1–0.3 range (H-02)

speed_insertion_ms.basis: arbitrary 4-point grid over the committed 0.02–0.15 range (H-02)

mu_contact.basis: arbitrary 5-point grid over the committed 0.1–0.8 range (H-03)

restitution_e.basis: arbitrary 4-point grid over the committed 0.1–0.4 range (H-03)

conf_min_attempt.basis: arbitrary 7-point grid over the committed 0.50–0.95 range, default included (D-017 — the tradeoff curve is the deliverable)

stiffness_k_n_mm.basis: IS §9.1 committed log grid (D-026); #63 feasibility mask applies at analysis, not here (D-028: emits data, not verdicts)

sigma_px.basis: PHASE1_PARAMETERS #40 committed sweep — realized D-046(a) (R01 F-009; the freeze ran pinned at 0.5)

host_pitch_deg.basis: D-024 attitude envelope ±20°; realized D-046(b) (H-17 closure)

host_roll_deg.basis: D-024 attitude envelope ±20°; realized D-046(b) (H-17 closure)

excluded.curve_set: the curve-swap seam, not a marginal axis — affected axes re-run under the ROADMAP swap protocol
